id: 16_Electrical Shock Causes of Electrical Shock How To Prevent Electrical Shock HSE
title: 触电的原因与预防
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/16_Electrical Shock Causes of Electrical Shock How To Prevent Electrical Shock HSE.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/16_Electrical Shock Causes of Electrical Shock How To Prevent Electrical Shock HSE/src.py

points.K3: 伤害难预料，事前消除危险
points.K10: 插头别沾水，线路不走湿地
points.K18: 高处作业离电力线10英尺

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a bright university lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 你好！今天说说电击从哪来。

shots.scene: 闪电、问号、盾牌三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a lightning bolt, a question mark and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 弄清原因，才知道怎么防。

shots.scene: 阿杰刚洗完手，手还湿着，伸手去拔仪器插头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, hands still wet from washing, reaches for an instrument plug at the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰手没擦干，就去拔插头。

shots.scene: 插座处冒出小火花，阿杰猛地缩手
shots.prompt_en: A small spark flashes at the socket and the young male student jerks his hand back.
shots.narration: 啪的一下，他被麻了一下。

shots.scene: 小研递给他纸巾，欣欣走过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands him a paper towel as the panda mascot walks over.
shots.narration: 还好只是麻一下，下次就不一定了。

shots.scene: 人形图标的手碰到带电导线，电流从手进入身体
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram touches a live wire and current arrows flow from the hand into the body. No people.
shots.narration: 身体碰到带电体，电流就进入人体。

shots.scene: 电流从手经过身体流到脚下的大地
shots.prompt_en: Current arrows travel from the hand through the body pictogram down to the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 人成了电路的一部分，这就是电击。

shots.scene: 从轻到重三个人形：皱眉、倒地、心电图停止
shots.prompt_en: Three person pictograms from mild to severe: a wincing face, a person on the ground and a flat heartbeat line. No people.
shots.narration: 轻的麻一下，重的会要命。

shots.section_title: 伤害难预料，事前消除危险
shots.scene: 人体轮廓里几条不同路径的电流箭头，问号
shots.prompt_en: An outline of a human body with several different current paths and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 电在体内怎么走，伤多重，难预料。
overlay: 伤害难预料，事前消除危险

shots.section_title: 伤害难预料，事前消除危险
shots.scene: 欣欣把一块挡板放在电源前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot places a protective shield in front of a power source icon.
shots.narration: 最好的办法：动手前就把危险消除。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起写着空白的原因卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with a warning triangle icon.
shots.narration: 电击常见的原因有四个。

shots.scene: 人形图标碰到带电线路，闪电
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram touching a live power line, with a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 第一，碰到了带电的线路。

shots.scene: 仪器金属外壳没有接地线，外壳带电发红
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument with no ground wire, its metal case glowing red with stray current. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，设备没有接地，外壳带了电。

shots.scene: 仪器旁的空白说明书被丢在一边，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank instruction manual tossed aside next to an instrument, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，不按规定的方法使用设备。

shots.scene: 电线被拉扯、打结、压在重物下的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cord being yanked, tied in a knot and squashed under a heavy box. No people.
shots.narration: 第四，电缆用得不对：拉扯、打结、重压。

shots.scene: 湿手伸向开关的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wet hand reaching for a switch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防电击第一条：不用湿手碰电器。

shots.scene: 阿杰擦干手再去拔插头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student dries his hands with a towel before unplugging an instrument.
shots.narration: 手湿最容易触电，先擦干。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着螺丝刀要拆冒烟的仪器，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a screwdriver toward a smoking instrument, and the scene is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 设备出毛病，别自己拆着修。

shots.scene: 老李拿着工具箱来检查
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer arrives with a toolbox to inspect the faulty instrument.
shots.narration: 交给合格的电工去修。

shots.section_title: 插头别沾水，线路不走湿地
shots.scene: 插头掉进水盆里的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plug falling into a basin of water, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 插头不能沾水。
overlay: 插头别沾水，线路不走湿地

shots.section_title: 插头别沾水，线路不走湿地
shots.scene: 电线横过湿地面的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cord lying across a wet floor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 地面潮湿，不在地上拉线。

shots.section_title: 插头别沾水，线路不走湿地
shots.scene: 电线沿墙上的线槽和桥架走到实验台
shots.prompt_en: Cables run along a wall-mounted cable tray up and over to a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 线路走线槽、桥架，从高处过去。

shots.scene: 三孔插头插入三孔插座，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A three-pin plug going into a three-hole socket, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 电器用三孔插头，接地脚别去掉。

shots.scene: 铜芯外露的导线图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wire with exposed bare copper, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没有绝缘的裸线，不用。

shots.scene: 手伸向裸线被挡开
shots.prompt_en: A hand reaching toward a bare wire is blocked by a stop symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 更不能伸手去碰。

shots.scene: 小研检查仪器插头接地脚和墙上的漏电保护器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the ground pin of an instrument plug and the earth leakage circuit breaker on the wall panel.
shots.narration: 开工前，确认设备接了地，

shots.scene: 漏电断路器图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An earth leakage circuit breaker icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 也接上了ELCB漏电保护。

shots.scene: 墙上一个裂开发黑的插座
shots.prompt_en: A cracked and scorched wall socket. No people.
shots.narration: 开关、插座、插头坏了，

shots.scene: 老李换上新插座
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a new wall socket after switching off the power.
shots.narration: 别拖着用，请电工换好再开工。

shots.scene: 老李戴绝缘手套、穿绝缘鞋
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on insulating gloves and insulating shoes.
shots.narration: 作业时，按要求穿戴防护用品。

shots.scene: 老李在配电箱开关上加锁并挂上空白标牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer locks a switch on the distribution box and hangs a blank warning tag on it.
shots.narration: 检修设备前，断电上锁挂牌，

shots.scene: 别人想合闸被锁挡住
shots.prompt_en: A hand trying to switch the breaker back on is stopped by the padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 防止别人误合闸。

shots.scene: 配电室门上挂着高压警告标志，阿杰停在门外
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops outside a switch room door that has a high voltage warning sign.
shots.narration: 工作场所有大电流危险时，

shots.scene: 推门进入的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person pushing open the switch room door, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 就不要在那里作业。

shots.section_title: 高处作业离电力线10英尺
shots.scene: 梯子上的人形图标与上方电力线之间有一段距离箭头
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram on a ladder with a distance arrow between him and an overhead power line. No people.
shots.narration: 高处作业，要和电力线保持距离，
overlay: 高处作业离电力线10英尺

shots.section_title: 高处作业离电力线10英尺
shots.scene: 距离箭头放大
shots.prompt_en: The distance arrow between the ladder and the power line enlarges. No people.
shots.narration: 至少10英尺。

shots.scene: 小研实验结束，关掉仪器开关
shots.prompt_en: At the end of an experiment, the female graduate student switches off an instrument.
shots.narration: 工作结束，关掉设备。

shots.scene: 外壳破裂、电线破皮的仪器贴着空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: An instrument with a cracked case and frayed cord, with a blank out of service tag attached. No people.
shots.narration: 损坏的电气设备，坚决不用。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with a lightning bolt icon.
shots.narration: 电击来自碰电、没接地、误用。

shots.scene: 湿手、裸线、破插座三个图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out in red: a wet hand, a bare wire and a broken socket. No people.
shots.narration: 不湿手，不碰裸线，坏了就换。

shots.scene: 接地、漏电保护器、锁和挂牌三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a ground symbol, an earth leakage circuit breaker and a padlock with a tag. No people.
shots.narration: 接地、ELCB、上锁挂牌，层层防护。

shots.scene: 开关关闭和停用牌两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a switch turned off and a blank out of service tag. No people.
shots.narration: 用完关设备，坏了不再用。

shots.scene: 欣欣、小研和擦干手的阿杰一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera with the female graduate student and the young male student, whose hands are now dry.
shots.narration: 擦干手，再用电，下次见！
